function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file from disk. Returns file content with line numbers.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List directory contents. Returns array of {name, type} entries.

function.name: search
function.description: Search for a pattern in files using grep. Returns matching lines.

path.description: Directory or file to search in (default: current dir)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories if needed.

content.description: Content to write to the file

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Apply a git-format patch to modify files. Prefer this over rewriting entire files.

patch.description: Patch content in git diff format

function.name: run
function.description: Run a shell command. Use for npm, git, and other CLI tools.

function.name: done
function.description: Signal that the spec is complete. Call this when all requirements are met.

summary.description: Brief summary of what was accomplished
